test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following got the Sangeet Natak Akademi 2017 for her contribution to Odissi dance?

options.text: L N Oinam Ongbi Dhoni Devi

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sujata Mohapatra **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shrimati Sujata Mohapatra** receives the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for 2017 for her contribution to **Odissi dance.**
 
• **Sujata Mohapatra** is actively involved in teaching Odissi.
 
• She is the Principal of **'Srjan' (Odissi Nrityabasa)**, a prime Odissi Dance Institution established by **MGuru Kelucharan Mohapatra She holds a master's degree in ****Oriya Literature from Utkal University, and has done research work at the Odissi Research Centre, Bhubaneshwar..**
 
• **In July 2011**, she opened an Odissi Institute - **Guru Keerti Srjan, in her hometown, Balasore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shobha Koser is an **Indian Kathak dancer, writer and teacher.****​** 
 
• **Rama Vaidyanathan is an Indian bharatnatyam artist from Delhi**. She is one of the directors of Ganesha Natyalaya, one of the best** Bharatanatyam institutes of the country.**
 
• New Delhi: President **Ram Nath Kovind confers Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2017** on Manipuri dancer L.N. Oinam Ongbi Dhoni Devi .
